## What changed (write scope only)

**`library/foundations/_pathway.md` → `## ordinals-and-cardinals`** (120 words)
Rewritten to keep the existing ordinal/cardinal, combinatorial, descriptive-set-theoretic, proof-theoretic, PCF, reflection, Boolean and large-cardinal strands, then cover the four gained A pages: preservation via closure/distributivity/chain conditions and nice-name counting controlling the continuum under Cohen, collapse and Lévy-collapse forcing; the choice-failure models (`Dedekind-finite` sets of reals in Cohen's first symmetric model, non-well-orderable atoms and countable pairs in the Fraenkel–Mostowski/second Fraenkel/ordered Mostowski permutation models, with the ZFA countable-pairs result transferred to ZF by Jech–Sochor); and finite-support ccc iterations forcing Martin's Axiom with $\neg$CH.

**`library/functional-analysis/_pathway.md` → `## foundations`** (120 words)
Keeps the normed-space/Baire/Fourier/Hahn–Banach/distribution/duality spine with its DC and $\mathrm{AC}_\omega$ boundaries, adds tempered distributions on $\mathcal S'$ (finite-seminorm criterion, weak/strong dual topologies, $2\pi$-normalized Fourier automorphism), and closes with Banach–Alaoglu, Goldstine, weak-star metrizability, the Krein–Milman/Bauer/Milman geometry, and reflexivity with $L^p$, Eberlein–Šmulian, Schur, uniform convexity, James and Bishop–Phelps. The existing locally-convex/continuous-separation close is retained.

**`library/measure-theory/_pathway.md` → `## sigma-algebras-and-borel-sets`** (119 words)
Keeps the measure/integration/$L^p$/representation/differentiation/interpolation strands with choice and sigma-finiteness hypotheses, and caps the dynamical strand with the gained ergodic-theorems page: maximal ergodic inequality → Birkhoff a.e. for $L^1$ on sigma-finite spaces, von Neumann's $L^2$ mean theorem, unique ergodicity, Weyl equidistribution, Borel normality, fair-coin strong law.
